description:
Download

Requirements: None!

Current Version: 1.5.5

Not compatible with existing saves from before v1.5.0!

Uncover the fragmented story of a distant binary system, and what became of it, through the vessels and blueprints you acquire. Codex entries have been scrubbed 'lost' over time. Collect them through exploration, underworld dealings, or lucky finds with Independents to access their descriptions.

Happy hunting, captain.

Changelog:

Spoiler
HPST v1.5.5

Anicetus deployment/supply cost increased from 100 -> 140
Coast now has Expanded Missile Racks as a built-in hullmod
Coast max flux increased from 6000 -> 7500
Coast ship system changed from Missile Autoforge -> Fast Missile Racks
Eliminator weapon mounts changed from 6x Small Composite 7x Small Ballistic -> 2x Small Missile 4x Small Composite 7x Small Ballistic
Guillotine hull reduced from 12500 -> 12000
Hummock ship system changed from Fast Missile Racks -> High Energy Focus
Tumulus deployment/supply cost increased from 60 -> 85
Unruly Choir flux per second reduced from 1600 -> 1200

---

HPST v1.5.4

Added version checker support for Lunalib
Reduced Remnant fleet sizes in the added star system (Changes will not reflect in saves before v1.5.4)
Adjusted planet orbit speed in the added star system (Changes will not reflect in saves before v1.5.4)
Anicetus deployment/supply cost decreased from 120 -> 100
Anicetus min crew reduced from 10000 -> 8000
Coast built-in missile autoloader removed due to author smoking crack and forgetting how to read
Coast deployment/supply cost increased from 40 -> 45
Coast hull reduced from 9500 -> 9000
Coast max flux reduced from 7000 -> 6000
Eliminator flux dissipation reduced from 700 -> 600
Eliminator max flux reduced from 8000 -> 7000
Guillotine deployment/supply cost reduced from 40 -> 35
Hummock deployment/supply cost reduced from 45 -> 35
Knoll deployment/supply cost increased from 20 -> 25
Knoll flux dissipation increased from 400 -> 500
Knoll hull increased from 7500 -> 8500
Loser flux dissipation decreased from 7000 -> 6500
Loser deployment/supply cost increased from 25 -> 30
Loser hull decreased from 8500 -> 8000
Mound max flux reduced from 6000 -> 5000

---

HPST v1.5.3

UF-03 no longer crashes the game when deployed

---

HPST v1.5.2

Fixed the issue of Gravharpoon not properly receiving "energy weapon" modifiers from skills and hullmods

---

HPST v1.5.1

Render error hotfix on the Gendarme, Loser, and UF-03

---

HPST v1.5.0

Download has been moved from google drive to github for all-around convenience

Attack run behavior of all wings now better staggers their formation when engaging

Nunatak Squadron has been made more aggressive to suit its strike fighter role

UF-02 will now loom closer to targets in order to maximize weapon use and reduce time spent repositioning

UF-03 has been fully reclassed into a close support wing able to stand out from its siblings

Drumlin Squadron max flux nerfed slightly due to fortress shield strength

Esker Squadron max flux nerfed slightly to reduce burst damage on opening volley as well as limiting their overall shot count

Scarp Squadron engagement range buffed to enable faster intercept of enemy fighters

Converted Lidar Array damage buffed to help finish off torpedoes when focus-fired

And something peculiar may now be found when exploring the edge of the sector

---

HPST v1.4.5

Added the Gravharpoon

Corrected the issue of the Locksmith missing a 0 on its hull value (aheh..)

Added 3 blueprint packages for easier collection

---

HPST v1.4.4

Added the Anicetus

Fixed an issue with fighters appearing as combat ships in colony production

Updated tags to display items properly in new codex

---

HPST v1.4.3

Blasted the mod in its entirety with the vanilla-friendly-inator

Every ship, fighter, and weapon has been altered to better match base .98a

---

HPST v1.4.2

Basic compatibility update for the 0.98a patch

---

HPST v1.4.1

Properly updated the download link with the right .zip file version, the previous left out the balancing changes made to the fighter wings.

---

HPST v1.4.0 "Look mom, I'm a ship and weapon pack too!"

Added the Hellbringer Cannon and Unruly Choir

Added the Mound

Fixed the issue with UF-03 going further beyond and spinning around its target at full speed

Adjusted the speed and maneuvering values of all fighters to better represent their intended roles

Cleaned Hummock sprite and fixed the asymmetry on the Guillotine

(Last planned update before .98 drops)

---

HPST v1.3.2

OP cost for UF-02 reduced to 34 and refit time reduced to 25

OP cost for UF-03 reduced to 40 and refit time reduced to 30

Kopje and Tauros correctly tagged as CIVILIAN craft

---

HPST v1.3.1

Fixed an issue with ships not spawning as intended with Independent fleets

---

HPST v1.3.0 "Heroes Never Die"

UF-02 and UF-03 Fighters Added

Fighter stat tweaks across the board, OP costs most notable

All Fighters readable in codex due to multi-para Fighter descriptions not being accessible outside of it

(Last additive update for a minute, but will handle balance adjustments as needed o7)

---

HPST v1.2.1

Fixed an issue with certain ships not spawning in the correct markets

---

HPST v1.2.0

Added the Nunatak Squadron wing

Fixed the credit values on Drumlin, Esker, and Scarp Squadron

---

HPST v1.1.1

Graphics fix on the Locksmith

Buffs across the board for the legacy wings to better match their desired effect

---

HPST v1.1.0 "I guess we doing fighters now"

Added Locksmith-class Battlecruiser

Added Drumlin, Esker, and Scarp Squadrons (rare fighter blueprints only the player can obtain)

Reduced Hummock hull integrity to 11000 from 14000

---

HPST v1.0.1

Fixed some typos in ship descriptions

Fixed the module floating issue with the Tumulus

---

HPST v1.0.0

Initial release for Starsector 0.97a

Special thanks to the great folks in the USC discord server for their general help and easy to follow guides.

VERY Special thanks to PigeonPun for help with the Tumulus sprite!
